# Quote cards and text posts

**Text-first posts and cards: when they beat video, type and contrast that read on a phone, sizes, alt text and honest screenshot cards.**

Makes text-first posts and graphics — plain text posts, quote cards, list and stat cards, and tweet-style "screenshot" cards of the account's own posts — with brand typography, WCAG contrast checks, per-platform canvas sizes, alt text that carries the full text, AI labels and approval-first publishing through @useclaudia/social. Use when a post is a sentence rather than a scene, when someone asks for a quote card, text graphic, tweet screenshot, text post or "notes app" style card, or when deciding whether an idea should be a text post or a video.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | beginner | 15–30 min per post | `@useclaudia/social`, `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Decide: text, card or video
2. Write the line first
3. Pick the card and set the type
4. Add a picture only if it earns it
5. Render and check on a phone
6. Write the alt text and labels
7. Keep screenshot cards honest
8. Publish with approval
9. Review after a week

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/quote-cards-and-text-posts.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/quote-cards-and-text-posts.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/quote-cards-and-text-posts.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/quote-cards-and-text-posts.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill quote-cards-and-text-posts`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `quote-cards-and-text-posts.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/quote-cards-and-text-posts`.
